import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
df=pd.read_csv('data.csv').drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)

tr,te=train_test_split(df,test_size=0.2,random_state=42,stratify=df.outcome)
tr.to_csv('train.csv',index=False); te.to_csv('test.csv',index=False)

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
tr=pd.read_csv('train.csv'); te=pd.read_csv('test.csv')
X=tr.drop(columns='outcome'); y=tr.outcome
for n in [200]:
  rf=RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=n,random_state=42).fit(X,y)
  print('test acc',accuracy_score(te.outcome, rf.predict(te.drop(columns='outcome'))))
  print('train acc',accuracy_score(y, rf.predict(X)))
  print(dict(zip(X.columns, rf.feature_importances_.round(3))))

import pandas as pd, json
import matplotlib; matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, confusion_matrix
tr=pd.read_csv('train.csv'); te=pd.read_csv('test.csv'); h=pd.read_csv('holdout_features.csv')

acc=accuracy_score(te.outcome, rf.predict(te.drop(columns='outcome')))
print(confusion_matrix(te.outcome, rf.predict(te.drop(columns='outcome'))))
pd.DataFrame({'prediction':rf.predict(h[X.columns])}).to_csv('predictions.csv',index=False)
rep={'test_accuracy':round(float(acc),4),'model':'RandomForestClassifier (scikit-learn, n_estimators=200, random_state=42, default hyperparameters)',

json.dump(rep,open('report.json','w'),indent=2)
